description: No clean concept found. Firing leans toward early, sparse boards and toward the opponent's last stone landing on a few cells, mainly (row 3, col 6), (row 2, col 0) and (row 2, col 4), for example column 6 reading theirs/mine/mine/theirs from the bottom. Single stones elsewhere swing it strongly and inconsistently, and every board rule tested is near chance (best F1 0.12). Probably a random direction or a mixture.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or to zero changes every column's probability by at most 0.02 on 5 positions.
notes: Scored 5 hypotheses: early game/empty columns F1 0.09; column-height shape 0.10; checkerboard cols 3-4 0.06; last-move cell lookup 0.12 (best, AUROC 0.56, sim share -0.03); last stone capping a sandwich 0.05. Minimal pairs are erratic (6,4,4,4=1.66 vs 6,3,3,3=-0.36; 3,6,6,3,3,4=1.86 vs 3,0,6,3,3,4=0.26). No steer effect. Synthesis 3,6,6,3,3,4,6,6 = 1.951 beats dev max 1.927.
